package.name: livox_ros_driver2
package.description: Messages-only stand-in for Livox' livox_ros_driver2 (CustomMsg, CustomPoint) so the simulation builds where the real driver / Livox-SDK2 does not (e.g. macOS). The .msg definitions are identical to the real driver, so the ROS 2 type hashes match. Do NOT build it next to the real livox_ros_driver2 (same package name).
